layout.tagline: Post what you want. Local and online sellers send you quotes.
layout.ccpa: Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information

form.off: This form is not switched on yet.
form.offContact: Please use the contact details on our Contact / Support page.
form.noscript: This form needs JavaScript (for spam protection).
form.requireOne: Please fill in at least one of: {fields}.
form.spamCheck: Please complete the spam check first.
form.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
form.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

home.title: {appName}: post what you want, get quotes from local sellers
home.description: {appName}: post what you want and local and online sellers send you quotes. Compare prices side by side, chat, and pick the best offer. Free for buyers.
home.lead: Stop calling ten shops. Tell {appName} what you need, and local and online firms compete to give you their best price. Compare quotes side by side, chat, and accept the one you like.
home.freeNote: Free for buyers. Your phone number is shared with a seller only after you accept their quote; before that you talk in the in-app chat.
steps: **Post a request in under a minute.** For example: *"{example}"*. Add photos, your {postalLabel} and when you need it.
**Get quotes from matching sellers.** Only sellers who sell or service that category near you can quote, and each request is capped so you are not flooded.
**Compare, chat and accept.** See price, taxes, delivery time, warranty and ratings side by side. Pay the seller directly the way you agree.
home.pricesNote: Median prices from quotes sent on {appName}, updated nightly.
home.sellTitle: Run a shop or a service business?

sellCards.title: Ready buyers, near you
sellCards.text: See requests from people who already know what they want, filtered by your categories and service area.

sellCards.title: Quote in seconds
sellCards.text: Send a price with tax, delivery and warranty from your phone. Chat once the buyer is interested.

sellCards.title: Verified and fair
sellCards.text: Get a Verified badge ({sellerIds}). Buyers rate sellers after each job, and any sponsored placement is clearly labelled.

home.dataText: {appName} is run by {company}. Your account data is stored in a {dataCentre} data centre and handled under {privacyLaw}. Read our [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy), or [delete your account](/legal/account-deletion) at any time.

og.detail: Compare quotes from local and online sellers side by side, chat, and pick the best offer.

sellers.title: Sell on the app: get local buyer requests
sellers.description: Join {appName} as a seller: see local buyer requests in your categories and send quotes from your phone.
sellers.lead: Buyers near you post exactly what they want. You send a quote. No cold calls, no ads to manage.
steps: Leave your details below, or install the app and choose **"I'm a business"**.
Add your categories, brands and service area ({postalLabels} or a radius around your shop).
Verify your business ({sellerIds}) to get the Verified badge and earlier access to new requests.
sellers.terms: Read the [Seller Terms](/legal/seller-terms) and [plan terms](/legal/subscription-terms) before you start.
sellers.consentContact: I agree that {company} may contact me by email or phone about joining {appName} as a seller. I can opt out at any time.
sellers.consentWhatsapp: Send me updates on WhatsApp from {appName}. At most one message a week; reply STOP to opt out.
sellers.privacy: We use these details only to help you join. See our [Privacy Policy](/legal/privacy-policy).
sellers.success: Thanks! We will get in touch to help you set up your shop.

og.detail: Buyers near you post exactly what they want. You send a quote. No cold calls, no ads to manage.

waitlist.title: Join the waitlist
waitlist.description: Get an email when {appName} launches in your city.
waitlist.intro: We are opening city by city. Leave your email and we will tell you when sellers near you are ready to quote.
waitlist.doubleOptIn: We send a confirmation email first (double opt-in). Nothing is sent unless you confirm.
waitlist.consentEmail: Email me when {appName} is live in my area, plus a few short tips on getting quotes. I can unsubscribe at any time from any email.
waitlist.consentWhatsapp: Also send me launch updates on WhatsApp. At most one message a week; reply STOP to opt out.
waitlist.success: Almost done: check your inbox and confirm your email.

og.detail: Leave your email and we will tell you when sellers near you are ready to quote.

about.title: About {appName}
about.description: {appName} is a reverse-quote marketplace run by {company}.
about.intro: {appName} turns shopping around: instead of you searching shops, you post what you want and sellers compete with quotes. It is a marketplace: we connect buyers and sellers but are not a party to the sale.
about.operator: {appName} is built and operated by **{company}**. There is one app per country so that each follows its own country's rules on what may be quoted and by whom. Our sister app for {sisterApp}; accounts and data are completely separate.
about.dataText: Our local price pages are built from anonymised quotes sent in the app. We publish medians and ranges, never a single quote, never a buyer's identity, and only once a city and category has enough data. Read our [editorial policy](/editorial-policy) for the details.

og.detail: A reverse-quote marketplace: you post what you want and sellers compete with quotes.
